answer: Costly admission with replayable challenges: each new identity must post a bond and answer a fresh, unguessable prompt; a copied or rehearsed answer burns the bond and demotes the sponsor. Scaling to N fakes costs N bonds and N distinct texts, and the anchor of every vouch is public and replayable. The hollow of a bad identity is easy to spot, while the relic of each caught copy stays on the ledger, so mass registration stays unprofitable.
